# PleebPot

## [v1.8.5](https://github.com/grimboso/PleebPotReminder/tree/v1.8.5) (2026-10-06)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/grimboso/PleebPotReminder/compare/v1.8...v1.8.5) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/grimboso/PleebPotReminder/releases)

- Fix event wiring for ready health items  
    Refresh runtime event wiring after cooldown readiness changes so UNIT\_HEALTH and UNIT\_POWER\_UPDATE listeners only remain active while the relevant item is ready. This prevents stale reminder behavior and ensures updates happen immediately when health stones, potions, or mana potions become usable again.

## [v1.8](https://github.com/grimboso/PleebPotReminder/tree/v1.8) (2026-10-01)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/grimboso/PleebPotReminder/compare/v1.7.1...v1.8) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/grimboso/PleebPotReminder/releases)

- Fix mana potion layout sizing  
    Refreshing the mana potion option now reapplies the UI appearance immediately. The holder sizing logic was adjusted to compute width and height based on the enabled potion rows and icon-only spacing, preventing the mana potion row from overlapping or clipping when toggled.
